method: Inspected the five-frame black-and-white comparison sheet at 0.55, 0.65, 0.75, 0.85 and 0.95 seconds, the full-size cover, and the edit/export audit; compared against the other seven black-and-white presets.

decisions.observation: Dense monochrome grain covers both flat and bright regions throughout the shot. This moving textured treatment is visibly unlike the smooth classic, hard contrast, soft bloom, negative, line-art, vignette and block-tone black-and-white entries.
